channel.description: Latest articles from Marin Independent Journal (marinij.com)

item.title: ‘Two peas in a pod’: Two decades after college, Vitello, Tingler reunited with SF Giants
item.description: Vitello was both a teammate and coach for Tingler at Missouri

item.title: Annette Rose, longtime political force in Marin, dies at 82
item.description: The former Sausalito City Council member and a Marin County supervisor was known as a stalwart advocate for the waterfront community.

item.title: MMWD dedicates 11 miles of Bay Area Ridge Trail on Mount Tam
item.description: The segments include parts of San Geronimo Ridge Road, Liberty Gulch Road, Bullfrog Road, Lagunitas-Rock Springs Road and East Ridgecrest Boulevard.

item.title: Marin education office plans $8.5M reserve for workforce housing
item.description: The reserve is intended as a cushion in case of lost rental income at the proposed Oak Hill complex for public employees.

item.title: SF Giants observations: Roupp ramps up for innings uptick
item.description: Landen Roupp and Matt Gage threw their first live bullpens of camp on Saturday afternoon

item.title: Valentine’s Day moment at first responder dogs event
item.description: San Rafael-based nonprofit First Responder Therapy Dogs hosted a Puppy Kissing Booth fundraiser, supported by the Novato High School First Responder Therapy Dog Club.

item.title: Prep wrestling: Carroll, De Jesus, DeKeyrel win NCS D2 gold
item.description: Novato High heavyweight Braeden Carroll added another title to his resume Saturday before he heads back to the North Coast Section championships looking to claim the championship that has eluded him. Meanwhile senior Sofi De Jesus of Archie Williams High and San Marin High’s Catania DeKeyrel were also crowned as girls shared the stage with the boys wrestling Saturday.

item.title: Sports Briefs: Dominican softball rallies past Central Washington
item.description: Dominican University softball rallied for a 5-4 victory Central Washington in non-conference action Saturday, closing out the Stan State Invitational at Turlock.

item.title: WCC men’s basketball: Gonzaga knocks off Santa Clara 94-86 to take over first place
item.description: Gonzaga disappointed a sold-out crowd at Leavey Center, snapping the Broncos' nine-game winning streak and sweeping Santa Clara in WCC regular-season play.

item.title: Boys soccer: Archie Williams claims elusive MCAL postseason title
item.description: A year ago, the Archie Williams High boys soccer team came off the field at San Rafael High after losing a heartbreaker to Redwood in the MCAL championship game – its fourth loss in four consecutive appearances in various finals.
